  3. Security-related publications in peer-reviewed conference proceedings or journals with a high citation index.
  4. Experience developing software with C, C++, Java, Python, or other scripting languages.
  5. Experience with cryptographic development tools/packages like SageMath.
  6. Deep knowledge of Linux, AGL, Android, and embedded operating systems.
  7. Expert in elliptic curve cryptography, post-quantum cryptography, and differential privacy.
  8. Advanced English level.

title: Mercado Financeiro – ESPECIALISTA FP&A – Bradesco – São Paulo
description:
Mercado Financeiro – ESPECIALISTA FP&A – Bradesco – São Paulo

Trazendo um pouco mais da nossa história de contribuição e impacto na sociedade, com pioneirismo e inovação, o Bradesco surgiu com o propósito de democratizar o acesso aos serviços bancários no Brasil. Nesses 81 anos, sempre ao lado dos brasileiros, nos tornamos uma das maiores Organizações do país, formada por empresas e fundações que oferecem produtos e serviços que vão de soluções financeiras a seguros, saúde e educação. E estamos sempre em busca de pessoas dispostas a fazer a diferença na vida de milhões de brasileiros, contribuindo para o desenvolvimento da sociedade.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Atuando dentro do departamento de Controladoria do Banco Bradesco, temos a missão de garantir à Organização informações gerenciais, resultados, análises e projeções com governança, bem como ser referência em análises, estudos e projeções de finanças para aumentar a qualidade e precisão das decisões tomadas pela Organização.

Modelo de trabalho: Híbrido (3 vezes remoto e 2 vezes presencial)

Como será seu dia a dia?

Como Especialista de FP&A, atuará na gerência de Finance Analytics e suas principais atividades serão:

  • Elaboração de estudos de performance financeira envolvendo business unit, produtos, canais e clientes que, além de trazer uma análise diagnóstica, possam influenciar por meio de recomendações as decisões estratégicas de negócios do Banco;
  • Analisar rentabilidade/resultado de produtos, clientes, segmentos comerciais, agências e canais;
  • Aplicação dos principais indicadores e técnicas em análises de demonstrações financeiras;
  • Elaboração e interpretação de P&L específico de grupos clientes, canais, segmentos, BU´s. Com profundidade de análise, incluindo projeções de cenários, investigação de variações e recomendações de oportunidades;
  • Aplicação de técnicas estatísticas descritivas e preditivas que suportem a análise da performance financeira e que tragam embasamento científico aos estudos da área;
  • Construção de Dashboard para suporte nas análises financeiras;
  • Desenvolver apresentações de alta qualidade e impacto para exposição a diretoria executiva;
  • Uso de tecnologias de dados como SQL, Python/R, SAS, Databricks, Power BI, Excel, para extração, manipulação e consolidação dos dados necessários aos estudos de performance financeira;
  • Articular temas com áreas parceiras, e apoiar/ensinar outros funcionários com menos experiência.

Requisitos e Qualificações

O que você precisa ter ou saber?

  • Graduação em Ciências Contábeis, Economia, Administração, Matemática, Estatística, Engenharias, Ciências Atuariais;
  • Conhecimento em análise de rentabilidade de produtos, canais e segmentos;
  • Domínio dos conceitos envolvidos nas demonstrações financeiras (DRE, BP);
  • Conhecimento em produtos e serviços bancários e mercado financeiro;
  • Experiência no setor de Bancos/Fintechs na área de Finance/FP&A;
  • Alta capacidade analítica, de atenção a detalhes e comprovadas habilidades em modelagem financeira;
  • Habilidades em manipulações de grandes massas de dados com uso de Linguagem SQL ou SAS para extração, agregação, relacionamento e enriquecimento de dados;
  • Conhecimento Avançado em Excel e Power Point;
  • Desejável conhecimento básico em R ou Python, e Power BI.
  • Desejável conhecimento em Estatística e métodos quantitativos para aplicação em estudos de performance financeira;
  • Boa comunicação em público e habilidade de se expor a diferentes audiências e entender como influenciá-las para garantir os melhores resultados;
  • Senioridade e desenvoltura para responder sobre temas à Diretoria;

In order to do this, we're continuing to hire Delivery Managers to work with our product teams to increase efficiency and productivity in the way they work. As a Delivery Manager, you are a leader within one or more software development teams, helping them be more productive through the management, coordination and facilitation of the team’s current operational workload.

This includes:

  • Proactively identifying and removing obstacles to progress;
  • Investigating, identifying and implementing changes to improve the systems, processes and tools employed by the team to deliver their work;

  • Contributing to the team’s strategic roadmap, and then ensuring the team’s activities align with it;

  • Contributing to defining, improving and implementing a standardised set of key practices within teams to ensure the entire organisation can benefit from established best-practice.

You are someone with great interpersonal skills who wants to understand the challenges their teams are facing. You help people find common ground and help them to achieve outcomes beyond what they thought possible. You are curious; you want to know how things work and enjoy thinking of ways to improve them.

You can adapt your approach to suit the demands of the situation. At some times, this may mean applying an analytical approach (i.e. gathering supporting data to justify a process change) and at other times, a people-focussed one (i.e. understanding the motivations of key stakeholders and finding ways to satisfy them for a true win-win).

You are a leader, who unites people and makes sure they have the support they need to succeed. You see a job well done as its own reward, as building and maintaining trust with your team is essential to success as a Delivery Manager.

If you come from a process engineering, change management, or project management background then we’d love to meet you. However, we also know that brilliant people can come from unlikely places and that titles don’t define you. If you have a solid track record with strong, transferrable skills that fit what you’ve read so far, we want to meet you.

Join to apply for the MÉDICO ORTOPEDISTA - HOSPITAL MUNICIPAL PEDRO II role at SPDM/PAIS - Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde

Desde dezembro de 2015, a SPDM/PAIS é responsável, em parceria com a Secretaria Municipal de Saúde do Rio de Janeiro, pelo gerenciamento do Hospital Municipal Pedro II .

A infraestrutura do Hospital conta com dez andares, nos quais estão distribuídos os serviços de emergência e de Unidade de Tratamento Intensivo (UTI) adulta, pediátrica e neonatal; maternidade; clínica médica, cirurgia-geral e bucomaxilofacial, neurocirurgia, psiquiatria, pediatria e ortopedia. Exames de imagem (raio X, tomografia, ultrassonografia, eletrocardiografia, ecocardiografia) e laboratoriais também são realizados na unidade.

Devido à grande população de idosos da Zona Oeste, região assistida pelo Hospital Municipal Pedro II (HMPII), há duas Enfermarias destinadas ao atendimento desse público.

O Centro de Tratamento de Queimados é outro diferencial entre os serviços oferecidos, e que dispõe de uma UTI exclusiva para prevenir infecções, que podem ser muito graves para quem está com queimaduras.

Além disso, a unidade conta com a Coordenação de Emergência Regional (CER) Santa Cruz, que possui 39 leitos, e tem como objetivo absorver as demandas de menor complexidade, deixando o HMPII liberado para os casos de risco iminente de morte, necessidade de cirurgia urgente e/ou internação. Um diferencial deste CER é o fato de possuir atendimento especializado em Psiquiatria e Obstetrícia.

At TRACTIAN, you'll break boundaries, question convention, and collaborate with top talent to drive real change. As a part of our growth-stage startup, you’ll work alongside the founders, shaping the vision, products, and experiences that will define the future of industrial tech.

Customer at TRACTIAN

The Customer team is the driving factor behind lifetime value, retention and expansion at Tractian. As part of this team, you will be in contact with clients to understand their needs and help create solutions to improve their maintenance processes.

What you'll do

As an Implementation Engineer at TRACTIAN, you will be responsible for deploying and maintaining cutting-edge Condition-based Monitoring (CbM) solutions for our industrial clients. You will work directly with Reliability teams, ensuring that best practices in asset management and predictive maintenance are effectively implemented.

You will lead the project implementation from initiation to Go-Live, ensuring seamless system integration into manufacturing and industrial environments. Additionally, you will conduct alignment meetings with clients, define deadlines and deliverables, and ensure the quality of project implementation.

Your role will provide clients with reliable tools to optimize machine performance and predictive maintenance. Your expertise will drive our mission to enhance machine reliability and operational efficiency.

  1. Project Management: Manage all project stages, ensuring that deadlines and deliverables are met within the stipulated timeframe.
  2. Client Alignment Meetings: Conduct alignment meetings with clients, define deadlines and deliverables, and ensure the quality of project implementation.
  3. Technical Asset List Review: Review the technical asset list, ensuring that all necessary information is available for a safe and effective project implementation.
  4. Process Mapping: Conduct a full process mapping of the client's operations, identifying key performance indicators, key users, and internal champions to drive project adoption.
  5. Master Field Installation Plan: Develop the Master Field Installation Plan, a technical reference document that will guide the installation process, prioritize sensor placement, and include the necessary regulatory standards to ensure proper sensor installation.
  6. Structured Handoff: Ensure a well-structured handoff process, guaranteeing the complete transfer of information to internal teams and securing the project's long-term success.
  7. Continuous Improvement: Collaborate with cross-functional teams to enhance system implementations and provide feedback on product development, ensuring solutions effectively meet industrial client needs.

  1. Bachelor’s degree in Engineering (Mechanical, Electrical, Production, Mechatronics, Automation).

  3. Solid troubleshooting skills with expertise in real-time monitoring.

  5. Excellent communication skills for client training and documentation purposes.
  6. Knowledge of maintenance performance indicators (MTTR, MTBF, MTTA, among others).

  8. Knowledge of CRM systems (HubSpot).

Bonus Points

  1. Advanced/Fluent proficiency in English and Spanish.

title: Manager, Commercial Planning
description:
Why PlayStation?

PlayStation isn’t just the Best Place to Play — it’s also the Best Place to Work. Today, we’re recognized as a global leader in entertainment producing The PlayStation family of products and services including PlayStation5, PlayStation4, PlayStationVR, PlayStationPlus, acclaimed PlayStation software titles from PlayStation Studios, and more.

PlayStation also strives to create an inclusive environment that empowers employees and embraces diversity. We welcome and encourage everyone who has a passion and curiosity for innovation, technology, and play to explore our open positions and join our growing global team.

The PlayStation brand falls under Sony Interactive Entertainment, a wholly-owned subsidiary of Sony Group Corporation.

Manager, Commercial Planning

S ao Paulo, Brazil (Hybrid)

The Manager, Commercial Planning will support demand forecasting across all PlayStation Categories (Hardware, Software and Peripherals) for the Latin America Region. In this role, you will collaborate with cross functional teams across Global, Americas, and local Latin American markets to contribute to a robust, consensus based demand plan. This position plays an important role in aligning demand with supply, improving forecast accuracy, supporting new product introductions, and driving S&OP processes to ensure operational efficiency and customer satisfaction.

You will have an opportunity to apply your business acumen, analytical mindset and organizational skills to help scale a growing regional business.

Reporting to the Head of Sales, PlayStation LATAM, this role supports key planning activities and offers visibility into strategic decision-making.

What You’ll Do:

  1. Lead and coach a regional commercial planning team, fostering collaboration, development, and performance excellence.
  2. Contribute to the development and execution of short- and long-term demand forecasts at product, category, and channel levels, using historical data, market trends, and promotional inputs.
  3. Support the S&OP process by working closely with Sales, Marketing, Finance, and Supply Chain teams to ensure alignment and accuracy.
  4. Act as a key liaison between regional sales teams, marketing, and operations to maintain coordinated and well-informed demand plans.
  5. Assist in building the yearly budget, quarterly forecast and monthly flash sales plans and follow its performance, reporting and explain variances.
  6. Support executive-level reporting and presentations with accurate and insightful forecasting data.
  7. Engage with channel teams to collaborate on forecasting and obtain and ensure that current and accurate information is used for demand forecasts.
  8. Monitor assumptions, risks, and opportunities impacting the demand plan, and communicate implications as needed.
  9. Review historical sales trends, research demand drivers, prepare forecast data, develop statistical forecast models, and evaluate results.
  10. Coordinate with Global and Americas planning teams to communicate market requirements and updates.
  11. Support Sales, MKT and Head of Sales on ad-hoc analysis to run the business. Manage day to day sales and planning operation.
  12. Improve data quality by ongoing validation & follow up of sell-out and sell-through.
  13. Understand new product introduction roadmaps to manage product transitions.

What We’re Looking For:

  1. 8+ years of relevant experience in Demand Planning, Supply Chain, Operations or Sales Planning.
  2. Bachelor’s degree in Business, Analytics, Engineering or related field.
  3. Past experience directly managing and developing a team while delivering strong business outcomes.
  4. Solid understanding of forecasting processes, S&OP, and commercial planning.
  5. Familiarity with planning tools such as SAP/IBP.
  6. Highly analytical, data-driven decision maker with strong organizational and prioritization skills.
  7. Ability to interpret complex data sets (both qualitative and quantitative) and present findings clearly and effectively.
  8. Collaborative team player with excellent communication skills and a solution-oriented mindset.
  9. Enthusiastic and confident team player with excellent verbal and written communication skills; able to connect and collaborate effectively across diverse teams. Brings an innovative mindset and learns quickly in dynamic environments.
  10. Clear and concise written skills. Ability to concept, write and develop persuasive, organized presentations.
  11. High level of organization and flexibility to deal with urgent requests.
  12. Proficient in Excel and PowerPoint.
  13. Bilingual in English is a must (Spanish is a plus).

  6. Capacidade de transformar dados em informações estratégicas para o negócio.

A Laços Saúde está pronta para receber você!

title: Graduate Legal Counsel - Tech Sector
description:
Join to apply for the Graduate Legal Counsel - Tech Sector role at Canonical

Join to apply for the Graduate Legal Counsel - Tech Sector role at Canonical

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.
We are expanding our in-house legal team, creating an opportunity for an exceptional recent graduate as junior Legal Advisor or junior Legal Counsel. The successful candidate will be a rigorous and effective practitioner with a track record of academic achievement and social engagement. At Canonical they will have the opportunity to work on a variety of transactional matters in the technology and enterprise software realm, as well as the contracts that underpin global employment, contracting and partnerships. In this appointment we are more focused on ability than experience; the position is open to applicants with a relevant degree, but does not have a requirement for extensive work experience. The successful candidate will work closely with our in-house legal team and colleagues worldwide.
Candidates must be able to demonstrate good commercial judgment as well as being organized, efficient, and capable to provide high quality legal and commercial advice. We are looking for a rigorous work ethic, detailed analysis, conscientiousness, and the ambition to identify opportunities for improvement.
Location : This role is home based in Europe, the Middle East, Africa or the Americas, with the option of our London office.
The role entails

  • Report to our global general counsel
  • Draft, review, and negotiate commercial contracts with customers and vendors in many countries across the globe
  • Provide legal support to various internal clients across the company, including Canonical's sales organization
  • Interface with cross-functional teams to support company initiatives
  • Utilize Canonical's contract management system to ensure accurate data is maintained for signed contracts
  • Work with local counsel in many countries to seek and implement advice
What we are looking for in you
  • An exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
  • A degree in law, JD or equivalent, and active license to practice law or current progress towards that
  • Drive and a track record of going above-and-beyond expectations
  • Strong organizational and prioritization skills with the ability to work in a fast-paced, multi-cultural environment
  • Effective both independently and as part of a team
  • A passion for technology evidenced by personal initiatives and projects
  • Professional written and spoken English with excellent drafting and presentation skills
  • Confidence to respectfully speak up, exchange feedback, and share ideas without hesitation
  • Appreciative of diversity; polite and effective in a multicultural multinational organization
  • Excellent interpersonal skills, curiosity, flexibility, and accountability
  • Thoughtfulness and self-motivation
  • Result-oriented, with a personal drive to meet commitments
  • Ability to travel twice a year, for company events up to two weeks long
Nice-to-have skills
  • Experience in commercial transactions, intellectual property, or corporate law
  • Leadership and the ability to influence others to embrace new ideas or practices
  • Understanding of the open source software community and values
  • Understanding of the technology industry - silicon, data centers, PCs, connected devices, and software
  • Experience working on in-house legal team and/or law firm
What we offer colleagues
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events
About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

Acerca del área de Estrategia y Transacciones

Como profesional de Estrategia y Transacciones en EY tendrás la posibilidad de asesorar a inversores estratégicos y financieros a lo largo del proceso de Due Diligence financiero y contable en fusiones, adquisiciones, escisiones y reorganizaciones de empresas, y dando soporte en la identificación de indicadores claves del valor de las empresas target y contribuyendo a mitigar los riesgos inherentes en una transacción de M&A tanto en procesos de “buy side” como de “sell side”.

Podrás sumarte a un equipo dinámico dedicado exclusivamente a transacciones que participa no solo en proyectos locales, regionales y globales para Argentina y Sudamérica, sino también de manera muy activa en procesos de M&A en Estados Unidos, brindando una experiencia internacional muy relevante.

  5. Asistir en el asesoramiento a los Clientes y en la preparación de los entregables con las conclusiones y recomendaciones a partir del ejercicio de Due Diligence.
  6. Asistir en la preparación de propuestas comerciales.

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.
We are hiring engineering managers who are passionate about operational systems, open source technologies and cutting-edge hardware to lead engineering teams to enable and optimize Ubuntu for the latest x86, ARM, RISC-V, s390x and POWER systems.
We partner with the world's leading silicon vendors to optimise Ubuntu on their latest platforms. We integrate next-generation features and performance enhancements in Ubuntu while also ensuring a common operating experience for their users.
Engineering Managers should be outstanding developers themselves. They should be completely at home reviewing a patch or a software design spec. You will be expected to drive healthy engineering practices, documentation, quality and performance optimisations as well as lead your team to deliver high-quality design and code.
An Engineering Manager is responsible for line management and career guidance. The ability to develop engineering talent, to represent your team and product from a technical perspective, and to drive collaboration with other teams and customers are all critical to success in this role.
You will have the opportunity to influence the culture, facilitate technical delivery, and work with your team on strategy and execution.
Location: This is a globally remote role. We have open positions in every time zone.
What your day will look like

  • Lead and develop a team of engineers, ranging from graduate to senior
  • Oversee commercial engagements and support timely delivery on agreed project milestones
  • Participate as technical lead on complex customer engagements involving complete system architectures
  • Implement disciplined engineering processes
  • Integrate and maintain platform-oriented software stacks
  • Optimize Ubuntu for latest hardware platforms
  • Display technical leadership internally and within our external communities
  • Contribute to code reviews and technical documentation
  • Be an active part of the leadership team, collaborating with other leaders

  • Exceptional academic track record from both high school and university

  • Confidence to respectfully speak up, exchange feedback, and share ideas without hesitation
  • Thoughtfulness, and self-motivation
  • Result-oriented, with a personal drive to meet commitments
  • Ability to travel internationally twice a year for company events up to two weeks long
Nice-to-have skills
  • Experience working with open source communities and licenses
  • Computer architecture knowledge of x86, ARM, RISC-V or s390x
  • Understanding of build systems and toolchains, including for cross-compilation
  • Experience working with customers
  • Experience with board bring up and validation
  • Experience with Linux virtualization, networking or graphics stacks
  • Experience with one or more of the follow
  • Experience with Docker/OCI containers/K8s
  • ing technologies: confidential computing, RDMA, Infiniband and high performance computing.

What we offer you
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person

About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Canonical has been a remote-first company since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.
